title: Quadrant Fill Code Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Apply the quadrant fill code bitmask by toggling individual quadrant bits and demonstrating how each combination changes which portion of an ellipse is drawn on a simulated frame buffer.
